summary: Revised implementation plan incorporating: (1) Default Logging Coach option in Staff Profiles to auto-select the owner when logging sessions, (2) Historical payslip continuity in the coach's 'My Pay' tab, (3) Streamlined payslip template (minimal labels, Banking Details, PAYSLIP title), and (4) Complete removal of pending payment badges, mark-as-paid, WhatsApp button, and legacy turn-in mechanisms.
